title: IncuBrix Transcript
description: Full transcript produced by the STT adapter, with deterministic word IDs.

words.description: Ordered list of words from the transcript.

id.description: Deterministic, index-based word ID: 'w0001', 'w0002', ... Never changes for this source.

text.description: The spoken word text (lowercased, de-punctuated by the STT adapter).

start_s.description: Word start time in seconds (from the source video).

end_s.description: Word end time in seconds (from the source video). end_s > start_s.

speaker.description: Speaker label (from diarization). 'default' when diarization is unavailable.

confidence.description: STT confidence score. Words below LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD are flagged.

flags.description: Flags set by the STT adapter or engine.

sentences.description: Sentence boundaries defined by inclusive word indices.

first_word_idx.description: Zero-based index into words[] of the first word in this sentence.

last_word_idx.description: Zero-based index into words[] of the last word in this sentence (inclusive).

speakers.description: Ordered list of unique speaker labels present in this transcript.

warnings.description: Warnings from the STT adapter (e.g. low overall confidence, VFR normalisation).
